Name: Squishi's Rideable Deer for Content Patcher and Alternatve Textures
Author: altroquinine
Description:
[i]Edit 1/25/25: I'm currently in my last semester of college and have been incredibly busy, so I haven't touched this mod in a long time. As of right now, this mod and all my others are on hiatus. While I am not aware of any bugs right now, I'm granting permission to edit the code and fix any that may pop up in the future. My only request is that you don't claim the entire mod as your own, especially since it uses assets from two other people that are not me.[/i]

Have you ever wanted to ride a deer in Stardew Valley? No? Well you should it's pretty cool... anyway now you can with this mod!

The art was made by my lovely partner, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/174554346]Squishroom[/url], and I did the modding side of things. The deer sprites are based off of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17245]Green's redesigned horse sprite by GreenJellyBlob[/url]. The sprites are fully updated with 1.6 to include the carrot eating animation.

Downloads.Description: Changes some stuff under the hood, but nothing fundamental has changed in game. See changelog for more details.
Adds Deerling as an alternative texture for the horse. Use the scissors to change the horse sprite.
